title: PaymentReceived
description: Emitted when a payment is accepted into the payment service (status PENDING), before allocation or processing.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the event occurred.

aggregateId.description: Identifier of the aggregate (the payment id) the event pertains to.

paymentId.description: Identifier of the payment within the payment service.

loanId.description: Opaque identifier of the loan this payment is for (owned by the loan domain).

confirmationNumber.description: Human-readable confirmation number assigned to the payment.
